title: jobsRecord
responsibility: Validate timezone-aware lifecycle flags and dispatch job starts or completions to the durable repository.

inputs.name: jobsRecord.history
inputs.description: Open JobHistoryRepository used for the action. The caller owns its lifetime unless withJobHistory opened it.

inputs.name: jobsRecord.phase
inputs.description: Lifecycle phase selected by the start/end CLI subcommand; start records identity and start timing, end completes an existing attempt.

inputs.name: jobsRecord.flags
inputs.description: Lifecycle identity, source, attempt and timestamp options. Attempt defaults to one and timestamp to the current clock; explicit timestamps require a timezone.

outputs.name: jobsRecord
outputs.description: Persisted start or completed job record returned by the repository after lifecycle validation.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Rejects invalid lifecycle timing, identity or scheduling flags before the operation can record or estimate work.
